import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = (1 << 19) | 5;
    static int n, k, p, max_power;
    static int[] count = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] f = new int[MAXN];
    static int[][] tmp1 = new int[20][MAXN];
    static int[][] tmp2 = new int[20][MAXN];
    static int[][] tmp3 = new int[20][MAXN];
    static long p_pow;
    static long[][] t = new long[20][MAXN];
    static long[] fact = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] inv_fact = new long[MAXN];

    static long bin_pow(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        long cur = base;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = res * cur % p;
            cur = cur * cur % p;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void setup() {
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= max_power; i++)
            fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % p;
        inv_fact[max_power] = bin_pow(fact[max_power], p - 2);
        for (int i = max_power - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            inv_fact[i] = inv_fact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p;
    }

    static int get_lower_bound(int x) {
        int res = 1;
        while (res < x) res <<= 1;
        return res;
    }

    static void performFWT(int[] arr, int len, boolean inv) {
        long[] temp = new long[len];
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) temp[i] = arr[i];
        if (inv) {
            for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < len; j += (i << 1)) {
                    for (int k = j; k < i + j; k++) {
                        temp[i + k] -= temp[k];
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < len; j += (i << 1)) {
                    for (int k = j; k < i + j; k++) {
                        temp[i + k] += temp[k];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            arr[i] = (int)((temp[i] % p + p) % p);
        }
    }

    static void modulate(long[] x) {
        for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
            if (x[i] >= p_pow) x[i] -= p_pow;
        }
    }

    static void combine() {
        for (int j = 0; j <= 19; j++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= max_power; i++) {
                tmp1[j][i] = 0;
                t[j][i] = 0;
            }
        }
        for (int j = 0; j <= max_power; j++)
            tmp1[count[j]][j] = f[j];
        for (int j = 0; j <= 19; j++)
            performFWT(tmp1[j], max_power + 1, false);
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {
            for (int l = 0; l <= 19; l++) {
                if (q + l > 19) continue;
                for (int s = 0; s <= max_power; s++) {
                    t[q + l][s] += 1L * tmp1[q][s] * tmp2[l][s];
                }
            }
        }
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= max_power; s++) {
                t[q][s] %= p;
            }
        }
        for (int j = 0; j <= 19; j++)
            performFWT(t[j], max_power + 1, true);
        for (int j = 0; j <= max_power; j++) {
            f[j] = tmp3[count[j]][j];
        }
    }

    static void combine_alt() {
        int[][] tmp = new int[20][MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= max_power; s++) {
                t[i][s] = 0;
            }
        }
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {
            for (int l = 0; l <= 19; l++) {
                if (q + l > 19) continue;
                for (int s = 0; s <= max_power; s++) {
                    t[q + l][s] += 1L * tmp2[q][s] * tmp2[l][s];
                }
            }
        }
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= max_power; s++) {
                tmp[q][s] = (int)(t[q][s] % p);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++)
            performFWT(tmp[i], max_power + 1, true);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= max_power; s++) {
                tmp2[i][s] = 0;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= max_power; i++) {
            int idx = count[i];
            tmp2[idx][i] = tmp[idx][i];
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++)
            performFWT(tmp2[i], max_power + 1, false);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        p = sc.nextInt();
        p_pow = 1L * p * p;
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(bin_pow(k, n));
            sc.close();
            return;
        }
        f[0] = 1;
        max_power = get_lower_bound(n + 1) - 1;
        setup();
        for (int i = 0; i <= max_power; i++)
            count[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
        for (int i = 0; i <= max_power; i++)
            tmp2[count[i]][i] = (int)inv_fact[i];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++)
            performFWT(tmp2[i], max_power + 1, false);
        int res_k = k;
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) combine();
            k >>= 1;
            if (k > 0) combine_alt();
        }
        long result = (bin_pow(res_k, n) - fact[n] * f[n] % p + p) % p;
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
